Official catalogs (e.g., Mar 24, 2025 IL/IN/WI catalog, https://www.tricociuniversity.edu/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/Student-Catalog-March-24-2025-IN-WI.pdf) list only founder/ownership/board/senior leadership and state that a 'Campus Administrative Staff and Faculty Listing' exists as a separate catalog addendum 'as needed', but that addendum is not posted publicly and was not found via site-wide search. Campus pages (verified Bridgeview, same template site-wide) show programs, awards, FAQs, and student testimonials only - no named instructor roster. Names mentioned in blog posts/testimonials are first-name-only or students, not a verifiable teaching-faculty roster with titles/departments, so nothing could be recorded without inventing data.
